annotations.title: What a pack holds and what it costs

description: Public. A PACK is a creator's priced set of rigs / skills / harnesses / agents — one purchase unlocks every item in it (one_time forever, monthly for 30 days, per_run spends the pack's runs across its items). Returns {pack:{id,title,description,seller,item_count,items:[{kind,ref,name,provider_id,external_id,run:{tool:'rig_run',args}}],private_items}, product:{id,model,price_cents,checkout_url}|null, buy}. To buy: product_checkout {product_id: product.id, rail: 'x402'|'usdc'|'sol' (agents, no browser) | 'card' (a human)}; then run any item normally (rig_run with the item's provider_id + external_id).
